messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: anomaly detected for inference-serving (us-west-2a). grpc_stream_resets up, 5xx_rate 8.3% (>5% threshold). Auto-run diagnostics triggered. thread_ts=5993332221
oncall-alice: ack — I'm on it. assigning myself and pulling dashboards.
sre-jordan: pulling host network stats now. seeing large RX dropped packet spikes on several g5 instances in us-west-2a — interrupts look elevated.
oncall-alice: can you paste ethtool / netstat outputs for a couple hosts?
sre-jordan: quick snippet from host i-0abcd1234: ```ethtool -S eth0 | grep -E "rx_dropped|rx_missed|rx_errors"
rx_dropped: 124312
rx_missed: 98765
rx_errors: 0```
we're also seeing increased retransmits at socket layer.
eng-matt: fyi autoscaler trying to add nodes but AWS returning capacity errors for g5 in us-west-2a: `InsufficientInstanceCapacity` on several launch attempts. so even if we want more capacity in 2a it's blocked.
infra-liz: summary: 1) per-host NIC RX drops causing stream resets, 2) inability to spawn new g5 capacity in us-west-2a. that explains sustained error rate.
oncall-alice: mitigations plan: a) apply on-host NIC workarounds where safe, b) enable cross-AZ routing for affected traffic, c) rollout quantized fallback model for latency-sensitive routes, d) update statuspage. executing now.
sre-jordan: applying on-host mitigation on three highest-error nodes (ethtool -K eth0 tx off sg off) — early signal: rx_dropped down ~70% on those hosts, 5xx rate down locally. monitoring fleet.
eng-matt: I've prepared a canary rollout to openfast-v2-quant for a small subset in us-west-2a to reduce GPU memory pressure and shorten tail latencies. will flip at 5993332298.
infra-liz: also starting warm nodes in us-west-2b and attaching to NLB target group for serving pool. note: customers pinned to dedicated us-west-2a pools will see reroute if we change routing policy.
cust-sre-nina: drafting status update: "Investigating elevated error rates and streaming interruptions in us-west-2a affecting inference requests for a subset of customers. Mitigations in progress (cross-AZ routing + on-host NIC fixes). Some customers may experience increased latency while traffic is rebalanced." ETA next update 20m.
tech-comm-rob: cc @cust-sre-nina — I'll prep customer-facing blurb once you confirm affected tenants. keep it conservative.
oncall-alice: affected: customers with dedicated pools pinned to us-west-2a + some hosted tenants with sticky sessions. @cust-sre-nina include that.
sre-jordan: fleet-level numbers: error rate was 8.3% at alert. after on-host toggles and partial reroutes it's at ~4.9% now. nodes we mitigated are ~3.2%. still limited by provisioning failures in 2a.
infra-liz: cross-AZ routing engaged at 5993332350 for new sessions (preference to us-west-2b/2c). sticky sessions retained for 30s for ongoing calls to avoid mid-stream cut. expect some warmup latency for rerouted traffic.
eng-matt: model rollout applied at 5993332298 for 10% traffic in the canary group. fallback triggered for requests with tail latency >2s.
cust-sre-nina: statuspage posted: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/usw2a-inference-net (initial incident notice).
tech-comm-rob: drafted customer note: "We're investigating higher-than-normal inference errors and latency in us-west-2a. We're rebalancing traffic and applying mitigations; we'll follow up with impacted customer list and ETA."
oncall-alice: current state: error rate stabilized near 4.5-5%. on-host mitigations helped but autoscaler still blocked in 2a. cross-AZ routing will keep things within SLO but increase p95 by ~50-100ms for rerouted sessions.
sre-jordan: monitoring packet counters and gRPC error streams. I'll capture host list and exact ethtool commands for postmortem.
oncall-alice: plan to hand off if stable: handoff TS 5993332500 to @sre-jordan for continued monitoring and postmortem writeup. escalate to infra if >3% 5xx persists for >30m.
sre-jordan: ack — taking handoff. will watch for 2 hours and start collecting host-level traces + customer impact matrix for postmortem.
oncall-alice: thanks team. I'll follow up with a short blameless summary once we have full host list. closing running actions in Slack thread, updates only if status changes. :white_check_mark:
